assumptions: The two sequences are homologous over the region aligned.
Scores are the substitution matrix's; a gap costs `gap_penalty` per column, or `gap_open` + k × `gap_extend`.
limits: One optimal alignment is returned; others with the same score may exist.
A local alignment with no positively scoring pair is refused rather than returned empty.
bio.jane/contract.question: How do these two sequences line up on their own, end to end or over their best-matching stretch?

description: Align TWO sequences on their own, globally (Needleman-Wunsch, or Gotoh with an affine penalty) or locally (Smith-Waterman / Gotoh), through biotite's `align_optimal` with the MSA panel's own knobs: substitution matrix, linear or affine gaps, and for a global alignment whether end gaps are charged.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

affine_gap.description: `true` charges separate opening and extension penalties (Gotoh); `false` one flat penalty per gap column.

align_matrix.description: the substitution matrix. `auto` reads the alphabet: EDNAFULL for nucleotides, BLOSUM62 for protein. Values: auto (Auto - from the alphabet), EDNAFULL (EDNAFULL - nucleotides (EMBOSS NUC.4.4)), BLOSUM62 (BLOSUM62 - amino acids).

gap_extend.description: affine only: the penalty for each column a gap is extended by. Negative. Only applies when affine_gap is true.

gap_open.description: affine only: the penalty for starting a gap. Negative. Only applies when affine_gap is true.

gap_penalty.description: the flat penalty per gap column. Negative. Only applies when affine_gap is false.

mode.description: `global` aligns the two end to end; `local` finds the best-scoring stretch shared by both. Values: global (Global (Needleman-Wunsch / Gotoh)), local (Local (Smith-Waterman / Gotoh)).

sequences.description: exactly two sequences: wire two upstream outputs here, or name two library documents.

terminal_penalty.description: global only: `true` charges overhanging ends like an internal gap; `false` makes them free. Only applies when mode is global.

name: align_pair

alignedSequences.description: the two aligned rows, {name, aligned}, over the aligned stretch

score.description: the alignment score under the matrix and gap penalties

spans.description: 1-based first and last residue of each input inside the aligned stretch

summary.description: the method, the score and where the aligned stretch lies in each input
